description: Find health tools and MCP servers by task or exact tool name. Local tool entries include input schemas for execute_tool. Indexed mcp_tool entries include the owning server, original toolName, and direct connection details. For schemaStatus=requires_connection, call tools/list on that server after connecting. Set include_locked=true to discover direct tools, servers requiring another connection, planned servers, and care services with no MCP server. Local_resource entries link to models that run locally; read their documentation before use. Use kind to narrow results.

include_locked.description: Also return entries that need another connection: direct MCP tools and servers, planned servers, and care services

kind.description: Only return entries of this kind

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return, 1 to 20

query.description: Task or exact tool name to search for, for example "find a payer endpoint" or "directory.search_endpoints"

name: search_tools
title: Search the Flexpa tool marketplace
